why.uz: Did dan keyin feʼlning asosiy shakli keladi: Did you watch...?
why.ru: После did идёт начальная форма глагола: Did you watch...?

stem.en: I was having a shower when the phone ___.

why.en: A short past action that interrupts a longer one is in the past simple: rang.
why.uz: Davom etayotgan harakatni boʻlgan qisqa oʻtgan harakat Past Simple zamonida boʻladi: rang.
why.ru: Короткое действие в прошлом, прервавшее длительное, стоит в Past Simple: rang.

stem.en: Have you ever ___ to London?

why.en: Present perfect is have + past participle; for visits we say have been to.
why.uz: Present Perfect = have + feʼlning uchinchi shakli; borib kelganlik «have been to» bilan aytiladi.
why.ru: Present Perfect = have + третья форма глагола; о поездках говорят «have been to».

stem.en: I have ___ finished my homework. Can I go out now?

why.en: Just means a very short time ago and goes between have and the past participle.
why.uz: Just — «hozirgina» degani, have bilan feʼlning uchinchi shakli orasida turadi.
why.ru: Just — «только что», стоит между have и третьей формой глагола.

why.en: Yet goes at the end of present perfect questions.
why.uz: Yet Present Perfect soʻroq gaplarining oxirida keladi.
why.ru: Yet ставится в конце вопросов в Present Perfect.

why.uz: Bir kishini butun sinf bilan solishtirganda orttirma daraja kerak: the tallest.
why.ru: Сравнение с целым классом требует превосходной степени: the tallest.

why.en: Than needs the comparative form: old becomes older.
why.uz: Than qiyosiy darajani talab qiladi: old → older.
why.ru: Than требует сравнительной степени: old → older.

why.uz: Kelajakdagi reja (next weekend) be going to + feʼl bilan ifodalanadi.
why.ru: План на будущее (next weekend) выражается через be going to + глагол.

why.uz: Bajarilishi shart boʻlgan qoida must bilan aytiladi.
why.ru: Обязательное правило выражается через must.

why.en: Sugar is uncountable, so we ask How much.
why.uz: Sugar sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun How much deyiladi.
why.ru: Sugar — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому How much.

stem.en: There were only ___ people at the party, so it was very quiet.

why.en: People is a countable plural, so a small number is a few.
why.uz: People — sanaladigan koʻplik ot, oz miqdor a few bilan aytiladi.
why.ru: People — исчисляемое во мн. числе, небольшое количество — a few.

stem.en: He speaks English very ___.

why.en: To say how he speaks we need the adverb well, not the adjective good.
why.uz: Qanday gapirishini ravish (well) bildiradi, sifat (good) emas.
why.ru: Как он говорит, описывает наречие well, а не прилагательное good.

stem.en: When I was a child, I ___ swim, but now I can.

why.en: Ability in the past is could; the negative is couldn't.
why.uz: Oʻtmishdagi qobiliyat could bilan, uning inkori couldn't bilan aytiladi.
why.ru: Умение в прошлом — could, отрицание — couldn't.
